capability_groups.label: eDiscovery
capability_groups.rationale: This is eDiscovery work — requiring evidence of it (any of: eDiscovery, e-discovery, Relativity, Nuix, EDRM, ESI, litigation support, document review, load files) keeps the shortlist on genuine eDiscovery candidates, not look-alikes who share only the base title.

limitations: Work mode (remote) is recorded for context; the search cannot filter candidates by work mode.
